Shingle Roofing Systems Available in Frisco

Asphalt Shingle Installation in Frisco

Asphalt shingles are North America's most popular residential roofing system, combining cost-effectiveness, proven Class A fire protection, and rapid installation.

Lifespan: 20 to 30 Years Wind: Up to 130 MPH (ASTM D7158 Class H)

Wood & Cedar Shingle Installation in Frisco

Natural cedar shingles and hand-split shakes deliver authentic rustic charm, natural insulating R-value, and organic architectural elegance.

Lifespan: 30 to 45 Years (with maintenance) Wind: Up to 120 MPH

Metal Shingle Installation in Frisco

Engineered stone-coated steel and stamped aluminum shingles combine the traditional aesthetic of slate, tile, or shake with the indestructible strength of metal.

Lifespan: 50 to 70 Years Wind: Up to 140–160 MPH

Rubber Shingle Installation in Frisco

Engineered from up to 95% recycled automotive tires and virgin polymers, recycled rubber shingles offer near-indestructible impact resistance, eco-sustainability, and authentic slate-shake styling.

Lifespan: 50+ Years Wind: Up to 130–150 MPH

Composite Shingle Installation in Frisco

Engineered from virgin resins and mineral reinforcements, composite synthetic slate and shake shingles deliver luxury aesthetics, Class 4 impact resistance, and a 50-year lifespan without structural reinforcement.

Lifespan: 50+ Years Wind: Up to 110–130 MPH

Slate Shingle Installation in Frisco

Quarried natural stone slate represents the pinnacle of luxury roofing, offering non-combustible fire protection and unmatched structural durability lasting 75 to over 100 years.

Lifespan: 75 to 100+ Years Wind: Up to 130+ MPH

Solar Shingle Installation in Frisco

Building-Integrated Photovoltaics (BIPV) seamlessly integrate clean solar energy generation directly into sleek, low-profile shingle tiles without bulky rack-mounted solar panels.

Lifespan: 25 to 30 Years (power output warranty) Wind: Up to 130 MPH

Frequently Asked Questions in Frisco

How much does a new shingle roof cost in Frisco?

For an average 2,000 square foot single-family home in Frisco, architectural asphalt shingle installation generally costs between $7,872 and $11,328. Final cost depends on roof pitch steepness, tear-off layers, and decking replacement needs.

How long does a roof replacement take in Frisco?

Most residential shingle replacements in Frisco are completed in 1 to 2 days by an experienced 5-6 person crew, weather permitting. Daily cleanup includes ground magnetic sweeps for nails.
